differences.a_observable: Background tiles in the upper and lower frame exhibit soft depth-of-field blur.
differences.b_observable: Background tiles remain sharp across the entire frame.
differences.fix: Enable camera depth of field and adjust aperture.

differences.a_observable: Cards cast distinct, dark contact shadows onto the tiles.
differences.b_observable: Shadows under the cards are faint and diffuse.
differences.fix: Adjust light source size to produce more defined contact shadows.

differences.a_observable: Corners of the frame are noticeably darker than the center due to a vignette.
differences.b_observable: Illumination is flat and even across the frame with no vignette.
differences.fix: Add a vignette effect in post-processing.

json.highest_impact_fix: Enable depth of field on the camera and adjust the light source parameters to match the reference shadows and vignette.
